crossRefs.note: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

parallels.note: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

translations.web: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
translations.bsb: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable to you.
translations.kjv: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination
translations.asv: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination unto you.
